Χριστοῦ, τοῦ Χρ., Ἰησοῦ Χρ., Ro 1:1, I Co 7:22, Ga 1:10, Eph 6:6, Phl 1:1, Col 4:12, Ja 1:1, II Pe 1:1, Ju 1; δ. τ. θεοῦ, τ. κυρίου, Ac 16:17, II Ti 2:24, Tit 1:1, I Pe 2:16, Re 7:3 15:3; δ. πονηρός, ἀχρεῖος, κακός, Mt 18:32 24:48 25:26, 30, Lk 17:10 19:22; δ. ἁμαρτίας, Jo 8:34, Ro 6:17, 20; τ. φθορᾶς, II Pe 2:19.
SYN.: διάκονος (q.v.), θεράπων, ὐπηρέτης (v. DB, iii, 377; iv, 461, 469; DCG, i, 221; ii, 613; Cremer, 215, 702).

title: δουλόω
content:
δουλόω, -ῶ (< δοῦλος), [in LXX for עבד ;]

to enslave, bring into bondage: Ac 7:6 (LXX), II Pe 2:19; metaph., I Co 9:19; pass., seq. ἐν, ib. 7:15; τ. θεῷ, Ro 6:22; τ. δικαιοσύνῃ, Ro 6:18; οἴνῳ, Tit 2:3; ὑπὸ τὰ στοιχεῖα τ. κόσμου, Ga 4:3 (Cremer, 217).†

title: δοχή
content:
δοχή, -ῆς, ἡ (< δέχομαι), [in LXX: Ge 21:8, Es 1:3, al. (מִשְׁתֶּה), Da LXX 5:1 (לְחֶם) ;]

a feast, banquet: Lk 5:29 14:13.†

title: δράκων
content:
δράκων, -οντος, ὁ [in LXX chiefly for תַּנִּין ;]

a dragon, a mythical monster: fig., of Satan, Re 12:3–17 13:2, 4, 11 16:13 20:2.†

title: δράμω
content:
δράμω, obsol.,

to run, v.s. τρέχω

title: δράσσομαι
content:
δράσσομαι [in LXX for נשׁק pi., Ps 2:12; elsewhere קמץ, as Le 2:2 ;]

to grasp with the hand, to lay hold of : metaph., c. acc (M, Pr., 65), I Co 3:19 (LXX).†

title: δραχμή
content:
δραχμή, -ῆς, ἡ (< δράσσομαι), [in LXX: in Hex. for in בֶּקַע, שֶׁקֶלII Es for אֲדַרְכֹּן, דַּרְכְּמוֹן ;]

a drachma, nearly equal to the Roman denarius (v.s. δηνόριον): Lk 15:8, 9 (DCG, ii, 200).†

title: δρέπανον
content:
δρέπανον, -ου, τό (later form of Attic δρεπάνη, < δρέπω, to pluck), [in LXX for מַזְמֵרָה, חֶרְמֵשׁ, etc. ;]

a sickle, pruning-hook; Mk 4:29, Re 14:14–19.†

title: δρόμος
content:
δρόμος, -ου, ὁ (< δραμεῖν, v.s. τρέχω) [in LXX chiefly for מְרוּצָה ;]

a course: fig., of life or ministry, Ac 13:25 20:24, II Ti 4:7.†

title: Δρούσιλλα
content:
Δρούσιλλα (Rec. Δρουσίλλα), ης, ἡ,

Drusilla, wife of Felix: Ac 24:24.†

title: δύναμαι
content:
δύναμαι, depon., [in LXX chiefly for יָכֹל ;]

to be able, have power, whether by personal ability, permission, or opportunity: c. inf. (M, Pr., 205; WM, § 44, 3) pres., Mt 6:24, Mk 2:7, Jo 3:2, I Co 10:21, al.; c. inf. aor., Mt 3:9, Mk 1:45, Jo 3:3, 4 Ro 8:39, al.; c. acc., to be able to do something: Mk 9:22, Lk 12:26; II Co 13:8; absol., to be able, capable, powerful: I Co 3:2 10:13.

title: δύναμις
content:
δύναμις, -εως, ἡ (< δύναμαι), [in LXX chiefly for חַיִל (חֵיל) , ץָבָא, גְּבוּרָה, עֹו, etc.; 35 words in all;]

power, might, strength; relatively, ability, power to perform: Mt 25:15, Ac 3:2, He 11:11; κατὰ δ., II Co 8:3; παρὰ δ., ib. ; ὑπὲρ δ., II Co 1:8; of pecuniary ability, II Co 8:3, Re 18:3; absol., power, might: Lk 24:49, Ac 1:8; opp. to ἀσθένεια, I Co 15:43 ; ἡ δ. τ. ἁμαρτίας, I Co 15:56; of power in action, Ro 1:16, 20, I Co l:18, Phl 3:10, al. ἡ δ. τ. Θεοῦ, Mt 22:29, Mk 12:24, Ro 1:20, al.; opp. to μόρφωσις, II Ti 3:5; in doxologies, Re 4:11 7:12, al. ; ἐν δ., Mk 9:1, Lk 4:36, Ro 1:4, al. ; of the power of performing miracles, Ac 6:8, II Th 2:9 ; pl., Mt 13:54, Mk 6:14, Ga 3:5, al. ; of the force or meaning of a word (Plat., al.), I Co 14:11. By meton., of persons or things;
(a) of God, Mt 26:64, Mk 14:62 (Dalman, Words, 200 ff.) ;
(b) of angels, Ro 8:38, Eph 1:21, I Pe 3:22;
(c) of armies, pl. [LXX for צְבָאוֺת], metaph., of the stars, Mt 24:29, Mk 13:25, Lk 21:26;
(d) of that wh. manifests God's power : Christ, I Co 1:24; τ. εὐαγγέλιον, Ro 1:16; ἡ δ. τ. κυρίου, I Co 5:4;
(e) of mighty works (Tr., Syn., § xci), δ. ποιεῖν, Mk 6:5 9:39; pl., Mt 7:22, Mk 6:2, Lk 10:13, al.; σημεῖα κ. δ.,. Ac 8:13 ; δ. κ. τέρατα κ. σημεῖα, Ac 2:22, II Co 12:12.
SYN.: βία, ἐνέργεια, ἐξουσία, ἰσχύς, κράτος (v. Tr., l.c.; Cremer, 218, 236; DB, i, 616; iv, 29; DCG, i, 607; ii, 188).

title: δυναμόω
content:
† δυναμόω, -ῶ (< δύναμις), [in LXX for עזז, Ps 51 (52):7 67 (68):28; גּבר pi., hi., Ec 10:10, Da TH 9:27 * ;]

to make strong, strengthen: Eph 6:10 (WH, mg.; ἐνδυν-, WH, txt., RV), Col 1:11, He 11:34.†

title: δυνάστης
content:
δυνάστης, -ου, ὁ (< δύναμαι), [in LXX for גִּבּוֹר, עָרִיץ, בַּיִת, etc. ;]

a prince, ruler, potentate: Lk 1:52; of God (Si 46:5, 16, II Mac 15:3), I Ti 6:15; of a high official (cf. δυνάσται Φαραώ, Ge 50:4), Ac 8:27 (Cremer, 221).†

title: δυνατέω
content:
δυνατέω, -ῶ (< δυνατός),

to be able, be powerful, mighty: c. inf., Ro 14:4, II Co 9:8; absol., opp. to ἀσθενῶ II Co 13:3.†

title: δυνατός
content:
δυνατός, -ή, -όν (< δύναμαι), [in LXX for גִּבּוֹר, חַיִל, etc. ;]

1. strong, mighty, powerful: absol., Lk 1:49, 1 Col 1:26; οἱ δ., the chief men, Ac 25:5 ; of spiritual strength, Ro 15:1, II Co 12:10 13:9; seq. ἐν, Lk 24:19, Ac 7:22 18:24; πρός, II Co 10:4.
2. C. inf., able to do; Lk 14:31, Ac 11:17, Ro 4:21 11:23, II Ti 1:12, Tit 1:9, He 11:19, Ja 3:2.
3. Neut., δυνατόν, possible: Mt 19:26, Mk 9:23 10:27 14:36, Lk 18:27, Ac 2:24 20:16; εἰ δ. (ἐστι), Mt 24:24 26:39, Mk 13:22 14:35, Ro 12:18, Ga 4:15; τὸ δ. (= ἡ δύναμις) αὐτοῦ, Ro 9:22.†

title: δύνω
content:
δύνω , Ion, and trag. form of δύω, [in LXX chiefly for בּוֹא ;]

to enter, sink into; of the sun (sc. πόντον), set: Mk 1:32, Lk 4:40

(cf. ἐκ-, ἀπ-εκ-, ἐν-, ἐπ-εν-, παρ-εισ-, ἐπι-δύνω).†

title: δύο
content:
δύο, numeral, indecl. exc. in dat., δυσί, δυσίν (Attic δυοῖν),

two: Mt 19:6, Mk 10:8, Jo 2:6, al.; with pl. noun, Mt 9:27 10:10, al.; οἱ, τῶν, τοὺς δ., Mt 19:5 20:24, Mk 10:8, Eph 2:15, al.; δ. ἐξ, Lk 24:13; distrib., ἀνὰ, κατὰ δ., two and two, two apiece: Lk 10:1 (WH, ἀνὰ δ. [δύο]), Jo 2:6, I Co 14:27; δύο δύο (= ἀνὰ δ., as LXX, Ge 6:19 for שְׁנַיִם שְׁנַיִם, but not merely "Hebraism," cf. μυρία μυρία, Æsch., Pers., 981, and for usage in π. and MGr., v. M, Pr., 21, 97), Mk 6:7; εἰς δ. (two and two, Xen., Cyr., 7, 5, 17), into two parts, Mt 27:51, Mk 15:38.

title: δυσ
content:
δυσ-

inseparable prefix, opp. to εὖ, like un-, mis- (in unrest, mischance), giving the idea of difficulty, opposition, injuriousness, etc.

title: δυσβάστακτος
content:
δυσ-βάστακτος, -ον (< βαστάζω), [in LXX for נֵטֶל, Pr 27:3 * ;]

hard to be borne: Mt 23:4 (om. WH, txt., R, mg.), Lk 11:46.†

title: δυσεντερία
content:
* δυσεντερία, -ας, ἡ,

Rec. for δυσεντέριον (q.v.), Ac 28:8.†

title: δυσεντέριον
content:
*† δυσεντέριον, -ου, τό (ἔντερον, intestine), late form of δυσεντερία (Rec., l.c.),

dysentery: Ac 28:8.†

title: δυσερμήνευτος
content:
*† δυσερμήνευτος, -ον (< ἑρμηνεύω),

hard of interpretation: He 5:11.†

title: δύσις
content:
δύσις, -εως, ἡ (< δύνω), [in LXX: Ps 103 (104):19 (מָבוֹא) * ;]

1. a sinking, setting, as of the sun (Æsch.): Mk 16 [alt. ending].
2. the sun-setting, the west (Thuc.).†

title: δύσκολος
content:
δύσκολος, -ον (< κόλον, food), [in LXX for אֵיד, Je 29:9 (Je 49:8) (of. δυσκολία, Jb 34:30; εὔκολος, II Ki 15:3) * ;]

1. properly, of persons, hard to satisfy with food, hence, generally, hard to please (Eur., Plat.).
2. Of things, difficult, hard (Arist.): Mk 10:24.†

title: δυσκόλως
content:
* δυσκόλως adv.,

with difficulty: Mt 19:23, Mk 10:23, Lk 18:24.†

title: δυσμή
content:
δυσμή, -ῆς, ἡ (= δύσις, < δύνω), [in LXX for בּוֹא, עֲרָבָה, etc. ;]

mostly in pl., opp. to ἀνατολαί;
1. a setting, as of the sun (acc. to Thayer, s.v., so perhaps in Lk 12:54).
2. the quarter of sunset, the west: anarth., Mt 8:11 24:27, Lk 12:54 13:29, Re 21:13.†

title: δυσνόητος
content:
* δυσνόητος, -ον (< νοέω),

hard to understand: II Pe 3:16.†

title: δυσφημέω
content:
** δυσφημέω, -ώ (< δύσφημος, slanderous), [in LXX: I Mac 7:41 * ;]

1. intrans., to use evil words (Æsch.).
2. Trans., to speak ill of, defame (Soph.): pass., I Co 4:13.†

title: δυσφημία
content:
** δυσφημία, -ας, ἡ (< δύσφημος, slanderous), [in LXX: I Mac 7:38, III Mac 2:20 * ;]

evil-speaking, defamation: opp. to εὐφημία, II Co 6:8.†

title: δύω
content: δύω, v.s. δύνω

title: δώδεκα
content:
δώδεκα, οἱ, αἱ, τά indecl.

numeral, twelve: Mt 9:20 10:1, al.; οἱ δ., the apostles, Mt 10:5, Mk 4:10, al.; in Ac 19:7 24:11, for Rec. δεκαδύο.

title: δωδέκατος
content:
δωδέκατος, -η, -ον

twelfth: Re 21:20.†

title: δωδεκάφυλος
content:
*† δωδεκά-φυλος, -ον (< δώδεκα, φυλή),

of twelve tribes: as subst. neut., τό δ. (cf. λαὸς ὁ δ., Sibyll. Orac.), the twelve tribes, Ac 26:7.†

title: δῶμα
content:
δῶμα, -τος, τό (< δέμω, to build), [in LXX for גָּג ;]

chiefly in poets and late (not Attic) prose;
1. a house, hall.
2. In LXX (and Hom., Od., x, 554; cf. MGr., terrace), house-top: ἐπὶ τ. δῶμα, Lk 5:19, Ac 10:9; ἐπὶ τ. δώματος, -άτων, Mt 10:27 24:17, Mk 13:15, Lk 12:3 17:31.†

title: δωρεά
content:
δωρεά, -ᾶς, ἡ (< δίδωμι), [in LXX chiefly (-άν) for חִנָּם, as Ge 29:15 ;]

a gift: Ac 11:17, Ro 5:15, He 6:4; δ. τ. θεοῦ, Jo 4:10, Ac 8:20; τ. Χριστοῦ, Eph 4:7; τ. πνεύματος, Ac 2:38 10:45; τ. δικαιοσύνης, Ro 5:17; τ. χάριτος, Eph 3:7; ἀνεκδιηγήτὶῳ δ., II Co 9:15. Acc, δωρεάν, adverbially (as freq. in LXX),
(a) freely, as a gift: Mt 10:8, Ro 3:24, II Co 11:7, II Th 3:8, Re 21:6 22:17;
(b) in vain, uselessly: Jo 15:25(LXX) Ga 2:21.†
SYN.: v.s. δόμα

title: δωρεάν
content: δωρεάν, v.s. δωρεά.

title: δωρέω
content:
δωρέω, -ῶ [in LXX: Ge 30:20 (זבד), Es 8:1, Pr 4:2 (נתן), Le 7:5 (15) (קׇרְבָּן), I Es 1:7 8:14, 55, Si 7:25 * ;]

to present, bestow. As depon. (with same sense), -έομαι, -οῦμαι: Mk 15:45, II Pe 1:3, 4.†
SYN.: δίδωμι, q.v.

title: δώρημα
content:
** δώρημα, -τος, τό (< δωρέω), [in LXX: Si 31 (34):18* ;]

a gift, boon: Ro 5:16, Ja 1:17.†
SYN.: v.s. δόμα.

title: δῶρον
content:
δῶρον, -ου, τό (< δίδωμι), [in LXX chiefly for קׇרְבָּן, also for מִנְחָה, etc. ;]

a gift, present: Mt 2:11, Re 11:10; of gifts and sacrifices to God, Mt 5:23, 24 8:4 15:5 23:18, 19, Mk 7:11, Lk 21:1, 4, He 5:1 8:3, 4 9:9 11:4; δ. θεοῦ, Eph 2:8.†
SYN.: s.v. δόμα.

title: δωροφορία
content:
* δωροφορία, -ας, ἡ,

a bringing of presents: LTr., mg., for διακονία, Ro 15:31.†
